engine_name: O2 Automatic Replanning & Change Detection Engine
description: Orchestration and change-detection engine comparing frozen upstream and downstream models over time

M4_RESOURCE_CATALOG_UPDATED.description: Hook for future educational catalog additions; downstream of skill needs

PATHWAY_PROGRESS_UPDATED.description: Hook for O4 learner milestone completions; does not modify skill demand

O5_GOVERNANCE_LEDGER_HOOK.description: Hook for appending cryptographic change events to enterprise audit ledger

materiality_definitions.HIGH_MATERIALITY: Structural outcome changes: top recommended role changed, CORE skill gap added/removed, required pathway step added/removed, or privacy threshold breached.
materiality_definitions.MATERIAL: Significant secondary changes: top-3 role membership/order change, IMPORTANT gap set change, recommended pathway order change, O1 top priority skill shift, or learning hours band shift >= 40h.
materiality_definitions.MINOR: Score or index movement with stable rankings, identical gap sets, identical pathway structure, and identical priority skill sets.
materiality_definitions.NONE: Semantically identical outputs across all evaluated dimensions.

privacy_safe_diff_strings.suppressed_to_visible: Previously suppressed; now above reporting threshold.
privacy_safe_diff_strings.visible_to_suppressed: Previously reportable; now below reporting threshold.
